confirmed_if: Hyperscaler capex falls quarter on quarter; GPU spot and traded prices fall for a full quarter; new neocloud deals sign below $20M per MW; the high-yield spread widens sharply
breaks_if: Capex keeps rising year on year; new deals keep pricing at or above $25M per MW with prepayments; spot stays tight
note: Debt is real; demand and prices are still rising

confirmed_if: Nvidia's filings show its neocloud backstops and stakes growing as a share of their funding; a neocloud's build stalls when Nvidia support is cut
breaks_if: New neocloud capex is funded mostly by customer prepayments and outside debt; Nvidia trims backstops and builds continue
note: Fits CoreWeave; Nebius's Q3 build was customer-prepaid. Nov 17: Nvidia discloses $32B of neocloud commitments and says new support will be selective

confirmed_if: Nvidia cancels or shrinks customer commitments or backstops; supply or roadmap slips; more senior departures; the export probe hits sales
breaks_if: Kress reaffirms commitments and backstops on Nov 17; the Q4 guide holds; no customer cancels
note: Nov 17: no commitment cancelled, Q4 guide $130B, FY28 growth raised to ~75%; board won't reinstate Huang

confirmed_if: A neocloud pulls or fails a raise; refinancing comes at sharply wider spreads; a build stops for lack of money (Applied Digital's 800 MW, Nscale's West Virginia site)
breaks_if: Nebius and CoreWeave close new debt at steady spreads; Applied Digital finances its 800 MW; prepayments plus asset-backed loans keep covering 75% or more of capex
note: Funding is dearer and shorter, not shut, except for the weakest

confirmed_if: The $7B ARR slips past February 2027; Q4 revenue lands below the $3.0B guide floor; more sites slip
breaks_if: $7B monthly ARR by February 2027; owned 2027 sites come online on time; Q4 meets guidance
note: Missed on timing; beat on revenue, margin and pricing

confirmed_if: B300 and B200 spot back at 60% or more of on-demand for weeks; traded prices keep rising; providers raise list prices again
breaks_if: Blackwell spot stays below 50% of on-demand (our thesis trigger); list prices are cut; short-dated $/MW falls
note: True for short-dated H100; Blackwell spot loosened in November

confirmed_if: A major lab or neocloud announces a large AMD or custom-chip deployment; AMD raises its data-center guide; Nvidia loses share in its results
breaks_if: No switching announcements; Nvidia's Q4 guide is strong; AMD's guide is unchanged
note: No customer switch reported; Nov 17 Nvidia beat and raised its FY28 growth outlook
